ResearchProjectDef.label: combined vaccine synthesis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Integrate discoveries across all tiers of Beyond Our Reach vaccine synthesis to engineer broad-spectrum combined vaccines and tenebral super-vaccines. Combined doses immunise against multiple pathogens simultaneously; tenebral formulations permanently rewrite the immune system at the archotech level.

HediffDef.label: tenebral bio-vaccination
HediffDef.description: This pawn's immune system has been fundamentally rewritten by tenebral archotech processes. All known biological pathogens are neutralised on contact. The continuous self-maintenance of this modification induces a constant low-level pain signal that cannot be suppressed.

HediffDef.label: tenebral mech-vaccination (I)
HediffDef.description: Tenebral tech has permanently integrated mechanite override protocols into this pawn's bloodstream, granting immunity against fibrous and sensory mechanites. The embedded protocols generate a constant low-level pain signal as they patrol.

HediffDef.label: tenebral mech-vaccination (II)
HediffDef.description: Tenebral archotech has permanently seeded this pawn's body with adaptive counter-mechanite nanobots tuned to MSMD-class mechanite strains. The counter-nanobots cause constant low-level pain as part of their vigilance cycles.

ThingDef.label: combined vaccine (base bio)
ThingDef.description: A broad-spectrum biological vaccine synthesised with Quasar-grade Beyond Our Reach solar compounds. A single dose confers immunity against all eight common biological pathogens. Due to the complexity of simultaneous multi-pathogen adaptation, only one vial can be produced per batch.\n\nRequires research: BOR Medicine II.

RecipeDef.label: make combined vaccine (base bio)
RecipeDef.description: Synthesize a combined standard bio vaccine using Quasar-grade Beyond Our Reach compounds. Yields 1 dose.

ThingDef.label: combined nano-vaccine (base bio)
ThingDef.description: A broad-spectrum nano-vaccine synthesised with Quasar-grade Beyond Our Reach nano compounds. A single dose confers long-duration immunity against all eight common biological pathogens. No cold storage required.\n\nRequires research: BOR Medicine II.

RecipeDef.label: make combined nano-vaccine (base bio)
RecipeDef.description: Synthesize a combined nano bio vaccine using Quasar-grade Beyond Our Reach nano compounds. Yields 1 dose.

ThingDef.label: combined tenebral vaccine (base bio)
ThingDef.description: A tenebral combined biological vaccine synthesised with Tenebral-grade Beyond Our Reach compounds. A single dose permanently reprograms the immune system to eliminate all eight common biological pathogens.\n\nRequires research: BOR Medicine III.

ThingDef.description: A super-vaccine synthesised at the apex of tenebral archotech medicine. A single dose permanently rewrites the recipient's immune system to eliminate all known biological pathogens and leaves a permanent tenebral signature in the body. The modification causes constant low-level pain (0.15) as the archotech processes maintain themselves.\n\nRequires research: BOR Medicine III.
